title: Love-Sick
summary: LOVE-SICK, adjective 1. Sick or languishing with love or amorous desire; as a love-sick maid. To the dear mistress of my love-sick mind. 2. Dictated by a languishing lover, or expressive of languishin

inlines.v: LOVE-SICK, adjective 1. Sick or languishing with love or amorous desire; as a love-sick maid. To the dear mistress of my love-sick mind. 2. Dictated by a languishing lover, or expressive of languishing love. Where nightingales their love-sick ditty sing.
